title: Structured-output stability playground and failure-injection harness
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a repeatable playground + harness that exercises JSON mode enforcement, constrained decoding, and schema adherence across streaming and tool-calling flows. The goal is to (1) surface brittle failure modes for partial/interleaved streams, (2) measure effectiveness of constrained sampling strategies, and (3) validate graceful fallbacks to compatible schemas or fallback parsers. This ticket builds the harness, a set of canonical scenarios, and automation for nightly regression runs against multiple model variants and runtime configurations.
acceptance_criteria: Playground can run a canonical suite of 25 scenarios including streaming partial JSON, interleaved toolcall tokens, and constrained-decoder timeouts
For each scenario the harness emits structured results: pass/fail, failure class (malformed-json, truncated-stream, toolcall-interference, sampling-explosion), and token-level diagnostics
Automated regression pipeline runs nightly against at least three model variants and records history to the structured-output dashboard
When constrained decoding failure occurs the runtime triggers configured fallback policies and the harness records latency/cost delta
Test scenarios include synthetic noise, upstream truncation, and adversarial prompt prefixes to ensure robustness
test_plan: Implement scenario definitions as YAML blobs referencing model, prompt-template, schema, and runtime flags
Add execution engine that can simulate partial stream chunks, inject latency, and interleave tool-calling tokens mid-stream
Wire harness outputs to an S3-compatible artifact store and update structured-output dashboard ingest to read nightly artifacts
Create CI jobs: unit tests for parser resilience, integration for end-to-end scenario runs, and nightly full-matrix runs on dedicated cluster
Run a 3-day soak with targeted fault injections (connection resets, KV-cache misses, quantization-induced token corruption) and iterate on fixes
implementation_notes: Reuse existing streaming test runner but replace brittle JSONrecovery heuristics with a pluggable decoder interface
Add a constrained-sampler shim that can toggle nucleus/top-k/temperature and track sampling entropy per-token
Instrument token-level traces: model logits, sampling decision, decoder state, and reassembly attempts for partial JSON chunks
Prefer lightweight Rust binary for chunked-stream simulation to avoid Python GIL artifacts; expose gRPC endpoint consumed by harness
Keep scenario definitions small and composable so PM/Ops can add customer-inspired cases without code changes
rollout_plan: Alpha: run harness internally against dev-models and runtime-1.20 on a QA cluster; gather failures and triage
Beta: enable nightly runs against curated open models and two private customer models; share results with Console team
GA: integrate pass/fail metrics into Console structured-output dashboard and enable alerting for regression windows
Fallback policy: default to schema-relaxed parse + best-effort mapping after two constrained-decoder retries; document in runbook
